description: A link that opens the free Six-IR resizer with a platform size picked and/or a maximum file size in KB set, so the person only has to add their photo. The photo stays on their device. Takes a size_id (such as ig-story or yt-thumb), a max_kb (for example 100 for a form that wants under 100 KB), or both.

max_kb.description: Largest file size allowed, in kilobytes (1 to 50000). Six-IR saves the best quality that fits.

size_id.description: A Six-IR size id, for example "ig-story" (Instagram Story) or "yt-thumb" (YouTube thumbnail).

name: make_resize_link
title: Make a Six-IR resize link
